sections.title: PortMiami Container and Break-Bulk Analytics
sections.description: PortMiami — the deepest port in the southeastern US, handling 900,000+ TEUs annually and serving as the primary US container port for the Caribbean and Central America.

blocks.heading: Container dwell and terminal analytics
paragraphs: ML for PortMiami's container terminals — predicting container dwell time, berth scheduling, and yard capacity utilization for the Port's operators managing the complex cargo mix of Caribbean and Latin American container trade.

blocks.heading: Break-bulk and project cargo analytics
paragraphs: ML for PortMiami's large break-bulk and project cargo operations — the specialized port services for oversized equipment, construction materials, and project cargoes flowing between the US and Latin American infrastructure projects.

blocks.heading: Port security and screening analytics
paragraphs: ML for the risk-based cargo screening programs at PortMiami — predicting which containers warrant additional CBP physical examination based on origin, shipper history, and commodity characteristics for the enormous US-Latin America trade flow through the port.

sections.title: Miami International Airport Air Cargo
sections.description: Miami International Airport is the US's #1 international cargo hub by value — handling $40B+ in cargo annually.

blocks.heading: Pharmaceutical air cargo temperature monitoring
paragraphs: ML for the temperature-sensitive pharmaceutical shipments from Latin America and Europe — predicting temperature excursion risk from carrier routing, aircraft hold assignment, and the specific ground handling time at MIA's cargo facilities where Miami's heat and humidity create temperature management challenges unique to subtropical South Florida.

blocks.heading: Fresh flower and perishable food analytics
paragraphs: ML for the cut flower imports from Colombia and Ecuador that make Miami the US's flower import hub — predicting perishable cargo quality on arrival from shipper, transit time, and temperature records, enabling customs brokers and importers to prioritize inspection and distribution of the highest-risk perishable shipments.

blocks.heading: High-value electronics and luxury goods air cargo
paragraphs: ML for the insurance, security, and customs priority management of the high-value electronics and luxury goods that flow through MIA from Latin America and Europe.

sections.title: Freight Forwarding and Customs Brokerage Analytics
sections.description: Miami's enormous freight forwarding community — serving the US gateway for Latin American trade.

blocks.heading: Customs clearance prediction and optimization
paragraphs: ML for the customs brokers and freight forwarders processing US import entries through Miami — predicting CBP examination selection, estimating clearance timelines, and optimizing documentation preparation for the complex multi-country Latin American trade flows through Miami.

blocks.heading: Bilingual supply chain documentation AI
paragraphs: AI processing Spanish-language shipping documents, Latin American customs documentation, and multi-country freight forwarder instructions in English and Spanish for Miami's bilingual freight forwarding community — the most linguistically diverse cargo gateway in the US.

blocks.heading: Cross-border compliance and denied party screening
paragraphs: ML for the compliance programs of Miami's large export trading community — automated OFAC screening, export license determination support, and country-specific trade restriction monitoring for exporters serving politically complex Latin American markets.

sections.title: Cold Chain Logistics (Pharmaceutical and Perishables)
sections.description: Miami's cold chain is the most complex in the US for Latin American-origin temperature-sensitive products.

blocks.heading: Pharmaceutical cold chain integrity
paragraphs: ML for temperature excursion risk prediction across the pharmaceutical supply chain flowing through Miami — connecting shipper temperature records, carrier performance data, and MIA and PortMiami handling time to predict end-to-end cold chain integrity for the DSCSA-regulated pharmaceutical products that flow through Miami.

blocks.heading: Fresh produce cold chain analytics
paragraphs: ML for the perishable produce importers using Miami as their US entry point — predicting shelf life on arrival, optimizing distribution timing, and routing fresh produce to the highest-value buyers before quality deterioration reduces value.

sections.title: Miami logistics AI technical context
sections.description: Key technical considerations for Miami logistics AI deployments.

blocks.heading: Bilingual logistics environment
paragraphs: Miami's logistics community is arguably the most bilingual logistics market in the US — Spanish is the working language of a large proportion of Miami's freight forwarding, customs brokerage, and port operations community. ClickMasters designs Miami logistics AI for Spanish-English bilingual operation as baseline.

blocks.heading: Latin America trade pattern complexity
paragraphs: The US-Latin America trade flows through Miami are more diverse in origin, commodity type, and regulatory framework than most US gateway markets — Brazilian imports under ECCN controls, Colombian perishables under FSMA, Ecuadorian cut flowers with USDA APHIS inspection requirements, and dozens of other country-specific trade frameworks create logistics AI complexity that requires deep trade regulation knowledge.
